# Resume & CV Craft - Free AI Resume Builder & ATS Resume Checker

> Resume & CV Craft (https://resume-cv-craft.web.app/) is a free, fast, and modern ATS-friendly online resume creator and CV builder.

## Product Overview
Resume & CV Craft enables job seekers, software engineers, students, and professionals to quickly generate job-winning resumes with real-time editing, ATS compliance, customizable templates, and instant PDF download capabilities.

## Key Features
- **ATS-Optimized Layouts**: Clean typography and structure easily parseable by Applicant Tracking Systems.
- **Free & Instant Export**: Download high-quality PDF resumes with one click without hidden subscription fees.
- **Guest & Account Access**: Start building immediately as a guest or create a free account to save drafts.
- **Real-Time Live Editor**: Interactive sections, skill tagging, and experience formatting.

## Usage & Access
- Website URL: https://resume-cv-craft.web.app/
- Primary Functionality: Resume Creation, ATS Checker, CV Generation, Career Document Export
